claim_title: text-danger on bg-danger/10 measured 3.95:1 (below AA) — design system had no danger-ink token
verdict: NOT REFUTED (claim holds) — but one evidence datum inside the claim is a probe artifact

what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.assertion: text-danger #E11D48 on bg-danger/10 over cream measures 3.95:1 (below 4.5:1 AA)
what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.method: independent WCAG relative-luminance recomputation in Python + live DOM measurement in the running app
what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.verdict: CONFIRMED — matches the claimed 3.95 exactly. Composited tint = rgb(252,231,228); fg = rgb(225,29,72).

what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.assertion: The design system had no danger-ink token before the fix
what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.method: git show HEAD:frontend/tailwind.config.js | grep danger ; git show HEAD:frontend/src/assets/design-system.css | grep danger
what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.my_value: HEAD has only `danger: '#E11D48'` and `--geo-danger: #E11D48` / `--geo-danger-fg`. No *-ink for danger, while accent/secondary/tertiary/quaternary/success/warning all had an -ink sibling. 0 hits for danger-ink at HEAD.
what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.verdict: CONFIRMED — the root-cause statement is accurate.

what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.my_value: Leaderboard.vue:23, Decks.vue:38, AdminDashboard.vue:9 all carried `... bg-danger/10 ... text-danger` at HEAD.
what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.verdict: CONFIRMED — line numbers in the claim match HEAD exactly.

what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.assertion: Pattern in ~10 components (Leaderboard:23, Decks:38, DeckDetail:16, AdminDashboard:9, AdminVideoAttempts:23, AdminVideoLessons:83, AdminSpeakingSubmissions:189, AiGeneratePanel:94)
what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.method: git show HEAD for each cited file
what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.my_value: Every cited file/line matched at HEAD. Working tree shows 36 bare text-danger call-sites replaced across 23 files; the 10 distinct components named are a fair characterisation of the affected views.
what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.verdict: CONFIRMED (minor: the counts are a subset description, not an exhaustive list).

what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.assertion: Fix: --geo-danger-ink #BE123C added, text switched to text-danger-ink
what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.method: read working tree design-system.css:39, tailwind.config.js, all *.vue
what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.my_value: Token present in both design-system.css and tailwind.config.js. 0 bare `text-danger` remain in frontend/src/**/*.vue (regex \btext-danger\b(?!-)). A fresh Tailwind build (npx tailwindcss -i src/assets/main.css) emits .text-danger-ink { color: rgb(190 18 60 ...) }.
what_i_confirmed_with_my_own_measurement.verdict: CONFIRMED — the fix is real and correct.

the_one_defect_in_the_claim.problem: 12.29:1 is a PROBE ARTIFACT. It is the ratio of rgb(30,41,59) (#1E293B, the inherited foreground) on the tint — NOT the new token #BE123C. The true post-fix ratio of #BE123C on rgb(252,231,228) is 5.29:1.
the_one_defect_in_the_claim.root_cause_of_artifact: The running Vite dev server (container engflow-frontend, StartedAt 2026-09-21T18:11:15Z = 01:11 +07) loaded tailwind.config.js at boot, BEFORE the file was edited (mtime 2026-09-22 03:33:58 +07). The served bundle therefore contains .text-tertiary-ink and .text-success-ink (v11 tokens, already in the config at boot) but NOT .text-danger-ink. With no rule, `class="text-danger-ink"` silently inherits #1E293B.
live_proof: document.styleSheets scan: find('danger-ink') = [] ; find('text-danger') = ['.text-danger'] ; find('tertiary-ink') = ['.text-tertiary-ink'] ; find('success-ink') = ['.text-success-ink']
getComputedStyle on a fresh div.text-danger-ink => rgb(30, 41, 59)
Forced error state on /leaderboard via page.route abort: alert className='... text-danger-ink', computed color = rgb(30,41,59), ratio 12.29
Fresh Tailwind CLI build of the SAME working tree DOES emit .text-danger-ink = rgb(190 18 60), i.e. the fix is valid; only the long-running dev bundle is stale
the_one_defect_in_the_claim.impact: The claim's headline (3.95:1 defect, missing token) is unaffected. The after-fix number is overstated (12.29 vs 5.29). Since 5.29:1 still clears AA, the conclusion 'fix works' survives — but the claim should cite 5.29:1, not 12.29:1.

probe_artefact_check.429_self_inflicted: NO — the finding is a CSS/DOM measurement, not an HTTP status; rate-limit buckets were irrelevant.
probe_artefact_check.guard_redirect_misread: NO — error state was forced deliberately via page.route abort, and the [role=alert] branch did render.
probe_artefact_check.genuine_artifact_found: YES — the stale dev-server bundle (see above), which inflated the after-fix ratio from 5.29 to 12.29.

severity_assessment.my_assessment: MEDIUM is defensible and internally consistent; arguably generous
severity_assessment.reasoning: It is a real WCAG 2.2 AA 1.4.3 failure and the project constitution P7 makes AA mandatory, across ~10 components. But it is a MARGINAL miss (3.95 vs 4.5 = 12% short) on a transient error state that most users rarely see, and the text remains legible. The project's own sibling finding F-13-03/04/05 — far worse violations (1.67:1 and 1.92:1) — was also rated MEDIUM. So MEDIUM is consistent with the project's rubric and not an over-claim relative to it. LOW would also be defensible for a marginal miss, but would be inconsistent with the siblings.

conclusion: The finding is substantiated by real, independently reproduced evidence: 3.957:1 measured and recomputed, no danger-ink token at HEAD, all cited call-sites verified, fix present and effective in a fresh build. refuted=false. One correction: the claim's post-fix '12.29:1' is a stale-dev-bundle probe artifact; the true value is 5.29:1 (still AA-passing).
